verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's proxy documents spend tracking for keys, users, and teams across 100+ LLMs, plus tag-based attribution. That spend sits in a self-hosted gateway with an admin UI, giving one place to see who is driving spend across providers. Spend metadata is still tracked even when message logging is disabled. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-model spend breakdowns, independent or hands-on corroboration of the spend dashboards.
